decision.why: Data and baseline inspection are complete. Read the format audit before spending an experiment on the enlarged Audiveris baseline, whose pilot melody error is 0.6692 and chord error is 0.7895.
decision.hypothesis: The benchmark audit can distinguish recognition failures from serialization or extraction failures, enabling a narrowly targeted first experiment.
decision.expected_observation: Evidence about image preprocessing, kern validity, chord extraction and transposition limitations sufficient to select a testable intervention without accessing reference labels during inference.

sources.title: Supplied-score benchmark and format audit
sources.claim: 32 development excerpts, seven songs. Enlarged Audiveris recovers 47/200 structured chords; Transcoda omits the chord spine and sometimes repeats notes. Plain OCR words are not yet promoted to harmony. Some outputs fail parsing.
sources.application: Separate image/model failures from output-format and text-to-harmony integration. Compare fixed paired inputs.
sources.limit: References unaudited; chord timing and human correction time unmeasured. No agent comparison.
